name: 재실 상태 감지 (Section 1)
purpose: Publish one section's occupancy flag from its presence sensors, holding 'occupied' through short dropouts (debounce) and writing only on change, and mirror the state on a section indicator light.

features.indicator: colour/brightness mirror of the section state (advisory)

roles.purpose: Report whether anyone is in the section, continuously.
roles.note: temporal=level is the load-bearing clause. A motion sensor reports the same BOOL property and passes every structural and type check, but it is a pulse: `present` would read false between movements, the 10 s grace would expire, and a seated occupant would be published as absent. Re-binding to a pulse source therefore requires an inserted latch and a re-tuned grace — fault class (b).

roles.purpose: The per-section flag the building aggregator reads.
roles.note: Consumer side is out of scope by the GV lock: this scenario is verified alone, with the key treated as an output.

roles.purpose: Show the section state as a colour, at a fixed brightness.
roles.note: The guards read back currentX/currentY/currentBrightness, so a substitute must expose its own state; a write-only light would loop on every tick.

params.name: section
params.note: Instance scope; changing it must move together with the GV key below.

params.name: absence_grace_sec
params.note: Debounce, not a cooldown on actuation: it decides how long a dropout is tolerated before absence is published. Its correct value depends on the bound sensor's temporal class, which is why (b) forces a re-tune and not just a latch.

contracts.statement: Presence anywhere in the section publishes occupied.
Absence is published only after the sensor has read false continuously for absence_grace_sec.
The section key is written only when the mirrored value changes (write-on-change).
Exactly one seed write happens on the first tick, and never again.
The indicator guards form a band around each target (39-41 brightness; ±0.01 around each colour point), so a satisfied state issues no command.
Both the occupied and the vacated branch stay reachable after any edit; in particular the grace must be larger than one period.

validity.note: The grace value is calibrated for a level sensor. A pulse source needs a latch plus a grace at least as long as the expected gap between pulses.
